application_type_full: Outline planning permission: Some matters reserved
description: The extraction of minerals and all necessary enabling works; hard and soft landscaping to create a new park; subterranean development to provide up to 177,500 (GIA) sqm of warehouse and storage floorspace (Class B8) and associated servicing and parking; alterations to existing vehicular access and creation of new vehicular accesses onto new public highway, including the creation of new pedestrian routes and the refurbishment and extension of the existing Rectory Farm buildings to provide associated park management accommodation, parking and facilities. Outline planning application with appearance, landscaping and layout all part reserved.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The first application for approval of reserved matters shall be made to the local planning authority before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission. All subsequent reserved matters applications shall be submitted no later than Ten years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - 2.	The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of two years from that date of approval of the first of the reserved matters to be approved.

Condition : 3 - 3.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until a programme of phasing for implementation of the whole development has been agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Any amendment to the approved phasing programme must be first agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

NB: The Local Planning Authority will require the provision of a proportion of the restored parkland prior to the completion of the warehouse development.

Condition : 4 - 4.	The submission of all reserved matters and the implementation of development shall be carried out in substantial accordance with the Design and Access Statement, Environmental Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Energy Statement, Outline Access Statement, Construction Method Statement, Planning Statement, Sustainability Statement and Transport Assessment received on 7th November 2016.

Condition : 5 - 5.	The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (089_P_10_02 Issue P6, 089_P_10_03 Issue P9, 089_X_10_04 Issue P5, 089_X_10_05 Issue P5, 089_P_10_06 Issue P5, 089_P_10_07 Issue P8, 089_P_10_09 Issue P8, 089_P_10_15 Issue P6, Unnumbered Drawing Showing Access to The Parkway, 089_P_11_02 Issue P7, 089_X_20_21 Issue P3, 089_X_20_22 Issue P2, 089_X_20_31 Issue P3, 089_P_20_21 Issue P3 089_P_20_22 Issue P3, 089_P_20_23 Issue P3, 089_P_21_21 Issue P4, 089_X_30_01 Issue P4, 089_X_31_01 Issue P2, 089_P_31_01 Issue P2, 089_P_32_01 Issue P4, 089_P_33_01 Issue P3, 089_X_41_01 Issue P3, 089_X_41_02 Issue P3, 089_X_41_03 Issue P3, 089_P_41_01 Issue P3, 089_P_41_02 Issue P2, 089_P_42_01 Issue P4, 089_P_42_02 Issue P3, 089_P_10_16_Issue P9 submitted on 7th November 2016 and 215579-00-SK-047 P3 received on 29 June 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 6 - 6.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until plans and particulars specifying the detailed proposals for all of the following aspects of the same phase [herein called "the reserved matters"] have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority for that phase. Thereafter the development of that phase hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

(i)	The reserved matters:

(a)	The design and external appearance of all buildings (including details of the colour and texture of external materials to be used);

(b)	Landscaping including a landscape design showing the planting proposed to be undertaken, the means of forming enclosures, the materials to be used for paved and hard surfaces, the design of street furniture and the finished levels in relation to existing levels;

(c)	The layout of the site, including park and recreational facilities and basement accommodation.

(ii)	Other matters:

(d)	The layout and design of proposed boundary treatment 

(e)	The location and design of waste and recycle facilities

(f)	The location and design and ventilation and access points serving the basement facilities

(g)	The extent of proposed excavation

(h)	A full geotechnical investigation

(i)	A quantative risk assessment

(j)	Confirmation of monitoring ground movements

(k)	A revised preliminary Unexploded Ordnance Assessment and a method statement for management of unexploded ordnance during construction

(l) Design measures for the development to connect to a future heat and on - site heat network

Condition : 7 - 7.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until the following details (which are relevant to that phase) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

The details shall be implemented in accordance with a phasing plan to be submitted as part of this condition:

(a)	Cycle parking

(b)	A Car Park Layout Plan, including provisions for persons with disability and differentiating between parking for the basement units and parking for users of the parkland above 

(c)	Electric vehicle Charging Points

(d)	A Car Park Management Plan, including provisions to review the parking levels as part of the phasing plan and in accordance with the principles set out within the S106 agreement

(e)	A Delivery and Servicing Management Plan

(f)	Vehicle routing (including the use of access points during construction)

(g)	A detailed design of the proposed vehicular accesses

(h)	Design of a shared use footway/ cycleway on Cranford High Street and Cranford Lane

(i)	A strategy for implementing the CERS and PERS reviews

(j) Details of phasing of works to Waggoners Roundabout

Condition : 8 - 8.	No development shall take place until a detailed scheme of highway works designed using the appropriate standard to increase capacity at M4 Junction 3, broadly in accordance with drawing number 215579-00-SK-047 P3, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with the Highways Agency. The submission will include a Stage 2 Road Safety Audit and a programme for traffic management. The scheme approved by the Local Planning Authority shall be implemented and completed in full prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted.

Condition : 9 - 9.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until a Noise Assessment, including methods for mitigation has been submitted for that phase to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The assessment shall include matters of vibration and shall refer to both the construction and end use of the development.

Condition : 10 - 10.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until an Air Quality Assessment, including measures for mitigation has been submitted for that phase to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The assessment shall include matters of dust and shall refer to both the construction and end use of the development.

Condition : 11 - 11.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until a finalised Energy Strategy (demonstrating how the targets for carbon dioxide emissions reduction are to be met in line with the Mayor's energy hierarchy) for each phase has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local planning Authority.

The development of each phase shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and shall not commence above ground until full Design Stage calculations under the National Calculation Method have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that the development will be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Prior to first occupation of the building(s) in each phase evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the National Calculation Method) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 12 - 12.	No building works in any phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until a BREEAM preliminary assessment estimator (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating how an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating will be achieved.

Within three months of work starting on site a BREEAM Design Stage certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) for each phase must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating will be achieved.

Prior to first occupation of the building(s) in each phase a BREEAM Post- Construction Review certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating has been achieved.

Condition : 13 - 13.	All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of 37kW and up to and including 560kW used during the course of the demolition, site preparation and construction phases shall comply with the emission standards set out in chapter 7 of the GLA's supplementary planning guidance "Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition" dated July 2014 (SPG), or subsequent guidance.

The developer shall keep an up to date list of all NRMM used during the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on the online register at https://nrmm.london/

Condition : 14 - 14.	Prior to each phase of development approved by this planning permission no development shall commence until a remediation strategy to deal with the risks associated with contamination of the site has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. This strategy will include the following components: 

1. A preliminary risk assessment which has identified: 
o all previous uses and proposed uses, 
o potential contaminants associated with those uses; 
o a conceptual model of the site indicating sources, pathways and receptors; and 
o potentially unacceptable risks arising from contamination at the site. 

2. A site investigation scheme, based on (1) to provide information for a detailed assessment of the risk to all receptors that may be affected, including those off site. 

3. The results of the site investigation and the detailed risk assessment referred to in (2) and, based on these, an options appraisal and remediation strategy giving full details of the remediation measures required and how they are to be undertaken. 

4. A verification plan providing details of the data that will be collected in order to demonstrate that the works set out in the remediation strategy in (3) are complete and identifying any requirements for longer-term monitoring of pollutant linkages, maintenance and arrangements for contingency action. 
Any changes to these components require the written consent of the local planning authority. The scheme shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 15 - 15.	Prior to each phase of development being brought into use, a verification report demonstrating the completion of works set out in the approved remediation strategy and the effectiveness of the remediation shall be submitted to, and approved in writing, by the local planning authority. The report shall include results of sampling and monitoring carried out in accordance with the approved verification plan to demonstrate that the site remediation criteria have been met.

Condition : 16 - 16.	The development hereby permitted may not commence until a monitoring and maintenance plan in respect of groundwater levels, quality and contamination, including a timetable of monitoring and submission of reports to the Local Planning Authority, has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. Reports as specified in the approved plan, including details of any necessary contingency action arising from the monitoring, shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 17 - 17.	If, during development, contamination not previously identified is found to be present at the site then no further development (unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority) shall be carried out until a remediation strategy detailing how this contamination will be dealt with has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The remediation strategy shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 18 - 18.	No infiltration of surface water drainage into the ground at this site is permitted other than with the written consent of the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 19 - 19.	Piling using penetrative methods shall not be carried out other than with the written consent of the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 20 - 20.	There shall be no: 
1. de-watering of the site 
2. interruptions to ground or surface water flows  without the written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 21 - 21.	The development hereby permitted may not commence until such time as a scheme to install underground tanks has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. 
The scheme shall include the full structural details of the installation, including details of: excavation, the tanks, tank surround, associated pipework and monitoring system. The scheme shall be fully implemented and subsequently maintained, in accordance with the scheme, or any changes subsequently agreed, in writing, by the local planning authority.

Condition : 22 - 22.	A scheme for managing any borehole installed for the investigation of soils, groundwater or geotechnical purposes shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The scheme shall provide details of how redundant boreholes are to be decommissioned and how any boreholes that need to be retained, post-development, for monitoring purposes will be secured, protected and inspected. The scheme as approved shall be implemented prior to the occupation of each phase of development.

Condition : 23 - 23.	No hazardous substances as defined by The Planning (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2015 shall be stored on site at any time for the lifetime of the development unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with the Environment Agency.
Condition : 24 - 24.	The site shall not be used for landfill.

Condition : 25 - 25.	No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Fridays, 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 26 - 26.	No phase of the development hereby permitted (excluding site investigations and demolition), shall commence until the applicant has submitted for that phase for review and approval by the Local Planning Authority, final detailed drainage designs (including drawings) of the proposed scheme agreed within the Flood Risk Assessment and Hydrogeological Risk Assessment (7/10/2016) and all other correspondence via email.

Condition : 27 - 27.	Prior to occupation of each phase, the applicant must submit for review and approval by the Local Planning Authority, evidence that the drainage system has been built as per the final detailed drainage designs through the submission of photographs and copies of installation contracts, and written confirmation that the drainage features will be managed as per the detailed maintenance plan for the lifetime of the development.
Condition : 28 - 28.	No building or structure of the development hereby permitted shall exceed 63metres AOD.
Condition : 29 - 29.	No trees and shrubs planted on the application site as part of the approved landscaping scheme shall be permitted to grow above a height of 63metres AOD.

Condition : 30 - 30.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until full details of soft and water landscaping works for that phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, details must comply with Advice Note 3, 'Potential Bird Hazards from Amenity Landscaping & Building Design' available at www.aoa.org.uk/operations & safety/safeguarding. asp). These details shall include:
- the species, number and spacing of trees and shrubs 

No subsequent alterations to the approved landscaping scheme are to take place unless submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 31 - 31.	The development is close to the aerodrome and/or aircraft taking off from or landing at the aerodrome. Lighting schemes required during construction and for the completed development shall be of a flat glass, full cut off design, mounted horizontally, and shall ensure that there is no light spill above the horizontal.

Condition : 32 - 32.	Prior to the use of the basement units and ground floor park within the Public Safety Zone hereby approved commencing details of activities proposed within this area shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall demonstrate that the proposal complies with the recommendations of the Department of Transport Circular: 01/2010 - Control of Development in Airport Public Safety Zones.

Condition : 33 - 33.	No demolition or development within a phase shall take place until a written scheme of investigation (WSI) for that phase has been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing. For land that is included within the WSI, no demolition or development within a phase shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed WSI, which shall include the statement of significance and research objectives, and
A. The programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed works
B. The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent analysis, publication & dissemination and deposition of  resulting material. This part of the condition shall not be discharged until these elements have been fulfilled in accordance with the programme set out in the WSI.

Condition : 34 - 34.	Detailed drawings of the proposed playing pitches together with changing facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works in that phase.

These details shall include the scales of the pitches, boundary treatment to the pitches, materials and any lighting proposed as part of the scheme.

Condition : 35 - 35.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until a lighting plan has been submitted to and approved in writing for that phase by the Local Planning Authority. This plan shall include all external lighting (including flood lighting to playing pitches) and provide details of hours of use, luminance levels and proposed mitigation strategies.

Condition : 36 - 36.	Prior to the commencement of development a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the site has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development of each phase hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 37 - 37.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until details of 'Secured by Design' have been submitted for that phase to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with the Metropolitan Police. The scheme shall be implemented in accordance with these details.

Condition : 38 - 38.	The living accommodation hereby approved shall only be occupied by a person or persons employed in connection with the maintenance of the surrounding land, or a dependant of such a person(s) residing with him/her.

Condition : 39 - 39.	Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 40 - 40.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until an updated Ecology Statement, including details of the ecology survey undertaken on the site, proposed mitigation measures and plans to enhance biodiversity on the site has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 41 - 41.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until a statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with Natural England outlining measures for soil handling, restoration and aftercare. A soil survey should be completed prior to submitting the information.

Condition : 42 - 42.	No phase of the development hereby permitted shall be occupied until a plan outlining foraging resources for pollinators and educational opportunities for the public has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 43 - 43.	No phase of the development comprising mineral extraction hereby permitted shall commence until a Mineral Statement has been undertaken and submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This shall include a Mineral Survey and details of measures designed to prevent entrapment of minerals, sterilisation and mixing. Works shall then be undertaken in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 44 - 44.	 No phase of the development hereby permitted shall commence until an Environment Management System for that phase has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Works shall thereafter be implemented in accordance with this information.
